SHENSHEN-SHENSHEN.title: Shenshen, Magical Girl of Light
SHENSHEN-SHENSHEN.description:
A development prototype of Shenshen, Magical Girl of Light.
The character has human and cat forms in her design; neither form is connected to combat yet. Stats, starting content, and visuals are development placeholders.
